slot: Privacy compliance (GDPR / UK GDPR / CCPA / India DPDP)

pick.name: Common Paper DPA + sub-processor list + RoPA
pick.what: Sign DPAs as processor, publish sub-processors, keep a record of processing, honour data-subject rights
pick.why: Free and covers what B2B buyers actually ask for

alts.name: Prighter (Art. 27 representative)
alts.why: Needed once you regularly process EU/UK residents' data without an establishment there

alts.name: CISO Assistant Community
alts.what: Open-source GRC with GDPR, DPDPA, SOC 2, ISO frameworks
alts.why: Tracks privacy controls alongside security frameworks

candidates.name: Prighter
candidates.verdict: Add when EU/UK usage is regular

decision: Build a baseline once and reuse it everywhere: DPA, sub-processor list, record of processing, rights-request process, breach plan. Add an Art. 27 representative if you regularly serve EU/UK users without an establishment. The regime that applies depends on where your users are, not where you are.
details: Merged the former India DPDP and GDPR/CCPA slots. DPDP penalty cap Rs 250 crore is from memory. Verify with a lawyer.

region_notes.EU: GDPR applies if you target EU residents; Art. 27 representative unless processing is occasional and low-risk.
region_notes.UK: UK GDPR + Data Protection Act 2018; a UK representative may be needed separately from the EU one.
region_notes.US: CCPA thresholds: over USD 25M revenue, or 100k+ consumers, or 50%+ revenue from selling data; other state laws have their own thresholds.
region_notes.India: DPDP Rules notified 13 Nov 2025; most data-fiduciary duties (notice, consent, 72h breach report, grievance, erasure, parental consent) apply from 13 May 2027 per law-firm summaries.

verify.note: Shallow; DPDP dates (Rules notified 13 Nov 2025, most duties from 13 May 2027) consistent with law-firm summaries.
